questions.question: National Youth Day is observed on 12 January to mark whose birth anniversary?
questions.rationale: Vivekananda was born on 12 January 1863; the day has been National Youth Day since 1985, honouring his hold on young India.

questions.question: National Science Day on 28 February commemorates:
questions.rationale: Raman announced the discovery of the scattering effect on 28 February 1928 — the discovery date, not the Nobel (1930) or a birthday, anchors the day.

questions.question: National Sports Day in India is celebrated on:
questions.rationale: Dhyan Chand's birthday (29 August 1905) is National Sports Day — the day the national sports awards are also conferred. 5 September is the Teachers' Day trap.

questions.question: Teachers' Day in India honours the birth anniversary of:
questions.rationale: The philosopher-president's birthday (5 September) became Teachers' Day at his own suggestion that it honour teachers rather than him.

questions.question: National Technology Day marks the anniversary of:
questions.rationale: The Pokhran-II nuclear tests of 11 May 1998 anchor the day. The 1974 'Smiling Buddha' test (18 May) is the deliberate decoy.

questions.question: The International Day of Yoga, first observed in 2015, falls on:
questions.rationale: Proposed by India and adopted by the UN in December 2014, the day is 21 June — the summer solstice. 5 June is World Environment Day, the paired trap.

questions.question: Constitution Day (Samvidhan Divas) is observed on:
questions.rationale: The Constitution was adopted on 26 November 1949 and came into force on 26 January 1950 — adoption and commencement are the two dates the paper swaps.

questions.question: Human Rights Day marks the adoption of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights in:
questions.rationale: The UDHR was adopted on 10 December 1948 — a declaration by the General Assembly, not a treaty, which is the follow-up distinction.

questions.question: National Mathematics Day commemorates the birth of:
questions.rationale: Ramanujan was born on 22 December 1887. The 'Raman-Ramanujan' pair — Science Day for Raman, Mathematics Day for Ramanujan — is the exam's favourite December confusion.

questions.question: World Health Day is observed on:
questions.rationale: 7 April marks the WHO's founding in 1948. 22 April is Earth Day — the two spring dates swap only for the careless.
